detail: The reported factory use requests "ED25519", which is a documented Java KeyPairGenerator standard algorithm name (WEB-002, WEB-009). KeyPairGenerator is expressly provider-based and its factory/initialization behavior is documented by the JCA API (WEB-001). The CrySL allowlist excludes this documented algorithm, but replacing it with RSA, EC, DSA, DH, or DiffieHellman would change the selected SSH identity algorithm, its encoded key material, and the application's advertised ED25519 support; it would not preserve what this code generates and later supplies for SSH authentication (SRC-001, SRC-008, SRC-009, SRC-010, CALLEE-003).
